title: AMConfigV1 fingerprints must exclude ResourceMetadata
answers: Why does saving a contact point / receiver bump its Version even though only provenance changed?
How should I compute Version for a new AMConfigV1 resource type (receivers, time intervals, inhibition rules)?
Version/Fingerprint keeps changing after provenance is stamped
body: Invariant: any content fingerprint used to derive Version for an AMConfigV1 resource (PostableApiReceiver, TimeInterval, InhibitionRule, TemplateGroup) must hash only the resource's actual content and must NOT include its own ResourceMetadata (UID/Version/Provenance). This lets provenance be stamped onto an already-fetched object later without invalidating the previously-computed Version, avoiding spurious optimistic-concurrency conflicts. Enforced by v1.ReceiverFingerprint in pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/legacy_storage/v1/receivers.go, which explicitly skips ResourceMetadata (mirrored by TimeIntervalFingerprint/InhibitionRuleFingerprint). A table-driven test (TestReceiverFingerprint 'stable across metadata modification') asserts this by reflecting over every ResourceMetadata field.
applies: Any new or modified AMConfigV1 resource type that embeds ResourceMetadata and computes a Version/fingerprint.
